resources.string: Pick an uncovered tile with its left or right side free.
Three uncovered tiles touch in a row. The left and right tiles are free; the middle tile is blocked on both sides. In the stack, the lower tile is covered and cannot be picked.
Follow the numbers: amber first, blue next or held match.
Your hand holds four tiles. Matching pairs disappear.
Three tiles are held: Teal Spell, Fern Trickster and Cherry Blossom. Picking another Teal Spell clears the matching pair immediately, leaving Fern Trickster and Cherry Blossom.
A matching fourth tile still clears.
Teal Spell and her portrait have different images and do not match.
Four unmatched tiles end the game. Clear every tile to win.
